title: CPCLDETECTOR: KNOWLEDGE ENHANCEMENT AND ALIGNMENT SELECTION FOR CHINESE PATRONIZING AND CONDESCENDING LANGUAGE DETECTION

bias_targets.target: Patronizing and Condescending Language (PCL) against vulnerable groups
bias_targets.methodology: Constructing a multi-modal dataset (PCLMMPLUS) that incorporates video, audio, facial expressions, text, and user comments, and evaluating a multi-modal fusion model (CPCLDetector) with alignment selection and knowledge-enhanced sentiment analysis to classify implicitly discriminatory speech.
